name: Sports
description: Kickoff and start times for games and sporting events that US fans plan around, with each time given in Eastern Time and converted to the other US time zones. Stories say where a game is shown in the United States only when the rights holder or the league lists it, separate confirmed listings from guesses, and never point readers to unlicensed streams. Every date and time is checked against the league or the broadcaster's own schedule. Pieces link to the monthly and weekly printable calendars so a season, a fixture list or a watch party can be written in ahead of time.
